name: Dr Kate O'Brien
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I’m Dr Kate O – Brien, a Clinical Psychologist with over 13 years – experience supporting people who have been impacted by trauma and life’s challenges. My work is grounded in an understanding of how trauma affects both the mind and body, and in the belief that healing happens best when we feel safe, supported, and understood. At Embrace Trauma Therapy, I offer evidence-based, compassionate mental health care for people navigating mental health concerns, past trauma, and periods of overwhelm or transition. My work is grounded in trauma-informed, relational, and integrative approaches to therapy. This includes drawing from somatic and nervous system – focused frameworks, alongside evidence-based psychological therapies, such as EMDR, IFS and other parts-work frameworks, and mindfulness practices.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Dr Pasquale Alvaro
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Pasquale has been practicing as a Clinical Psychologist since 2020, working with adults and older adolescents. He has extensive experience in public psychiatry, private practice, and specialist services, working in settings such as an adult inpatient unit, community psychiatry, acute concussion clinic, and psychological trauma services.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Matthew Wade
title: Psychologist
description: Matthew is a clinical psychologist who offers telehealth therapy for clients age twelve and up. He takes a compassionate, pragmatic, and evidence-based approach to treatment. Matthew has extensive experience with anxiety, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), phobia, trauma, PTSD, depression, ADHD, anger management, grief, insomnia, persistent pain, addiction, and personality disorder. Matthew employs evidence-based treatments tailored to client needs, including cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), motivational interviewing, and schema therapy.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Patricia Evans
title: Psychologist
description: I hold a Master of Clinical Psychology and am registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) and a member of the Australian Psychological Society (APS). I have experience with clients across the lifespan and facing diverse psychological and emotional challenges, including depression, anxiety, trauma, PTSD, and sleep disturbances. I have a particular interest in supporting healthcare workers in overcoming work-related trauma. I value warmth and empathy, to build solid therapeutic relationships, and work with evidence-based frameworks, drawing from CBT, ACT, mindfulness-based CBT, and EMDR.
specialties: Sex worker issues, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, EMDR, Schema Therapy
